title: Disney+: New user agreement allows ads before movies in all subscriptions
summary: Disney+ is implementing a new user agreement that will display advertisements before movies across all subscription tiers, including previously ad-free premium subscriptions, representing a significant shift in their monetization strategy for the streaming platform.
problem_solved: Disney+ is addressing revenue optimization by introducing ads across all subscription tiers, eliminating the ad-free experience for premium subscribers.
why_valuable: This change affects millions of subscribers who paid for ad-free experiences, raising important questions about consumer rights and contractual transparency in streaming services.
